name: plugins
description: Cursor plugin specification and official plugins
one_liner: Cursor's official app-store of plug-ins that connect its AI coding assistant to real tools like Gmail, Salesforce, GitHub, and Zoom, plus internal workflow add-ons.
buyer: A SaaS company that wants its product listed as an official Cursor integration so developers using Cursor can control it with natural language.
business_use_cases: A SaaS vendor publishes an official Cursor plugin so their product becomes reachable from inside every subscriber's coding assistant.
An internal platform team builds a private company plugin, for example for a deploy pipeline, so every engineer's Cursor instance can trigger deploys safely.
A consultancy builds and sells bespoke Cursor plugins for clients' internal tools, like CRMs or ticketing systems, that have no existing integration.

money_ideas.idea: Build and sell a custom integration plugin for a niche SaaS tool that isn't yet listed, as a one-off dev contract.

steal_this: Pick a tool your own team uses daily with no Cursor plugin yet, build a thin wrapper this weekend, and offer it to that tool's other users.
